title: Compatible lifting of an idempotent to the formal-fibre section limit
statement: Let f:X→S be a morphism of schemes, s∈S, A=O_(S,s) and m its maximal ideal. Use the formal-fibre section system [def-weil-pbc-formal-fibre-cohomology]: X_n=Spec(A/m^(n+1))×_S X, its section modules over the completed ring, and restriction transitions. For every idempotent e∈Γ(X_0,O), there exists an element v of the inverse limit of these section modules whose zeroth projection equals e. No properness, Noetherian or henselian hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0G7X, Noetherian paragraph, infinitesimal idempotent lifting (lines 8133--8146); verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0G7X

proof.text: For each n and idempotent section a_n, use unique one-step lifting to choose a_(n+1) restricting to a_n. Starting at the prescribed e, dependent recursion constructs the sequence a_n of idempotents. These choices are determined uniquely at each step.

For the completed local ring R, define the n-th leg R → Γ(X_n,O) by r ↦ r a_n. Since restriction is R-linear and sends a_(n+1) to a_n, the legs commute with each successor transition. NatTrans.ofOpSequence supplies naturality for all arrows and hence a cone with vertex R. Apply limit.lift to 1 in R; limit.lift_π and 1 a_0 = e prove its zeroth projection is e.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0G7X, compatible infinitesimal idempotents; dependent recursion and the universal property of the section-module limit (G2 second reading).

lean.statement: theorem formalFibre_idempotent_limit {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (s : S) (e : Γ(formalFibre f s 0, ⊤)) (he : IsIdempotentElem e) : ∃ v : ↥(limit (formalFibreSectionsSystem f s)), (limit.π (formalFibreSectionsSystem f s) (op 0)) v = e
